title: SF3865 (2019-2020 Regular): Noncitizen permit to carry firearm applicant background check information collection expansion

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/91/2020/0/SF/3865/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version (as filed); no date or vote. Struck words only tidy the list punctuation. The text file does not show which words are new; the IAQ sentence is judged new from the bill title. Per ruling, the immigration query on a background check is not a deportation topic.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3): (7) if the applicant is not a United States citizen, the applicant's country of birth and alien number or alien admission number.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 4): In addition, if the applicant is not a United States citizen, the sheriff must ensure that an Immigration Alien Query (IAQ) check is performed on the applicant.
